words.ex: He bruised his knee when he fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔下来时擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: A bruise is a mark that appears on your skin after you have been injured, but the skin is not broken.

words.tr: v. （使）断裂；
words.ex: He fractured his arm during the soccer game.
words.ex_cn: 他在足球比赛中摔断了手臂。
words.en: If something such as a bone fractures or is fractured, it breaks or cracks.

words.tr: phrase. 变得破碎的；发生骨折的
words.ex: The bone can get fractured if you fall badly.
words.ex_cn: 如果你摔得很重，骨头可能会骨折。
words.en: To break or cause to break.

words.tr: phrase. 折断骨头；使骨折
words.ex: He fell off his bike and broke bones in his arm.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔下来，弄断了手臂的骨头。
words.en: To cause a bone to fracture or break.

words.tr: phrase. 弄断了我的腿；腿部骨折
words.ex: I broke my leg while skiing last winter.
words.ex_cn: v. 去年冬天滑雪时我摔断了腿。
words.en: To fracture one's leg bone, typically as a result of an accident or injury.

words.tr: phrase. 弄断了我的腿；使我的腿骨折
words.ex: I fractured my leg while skiing.
words.ex_cn: 我在滑雪时摔断了腿。
words.en: To break a bone in your leg.

words.tr: 名词短语，指我腿上的骨折
words.ex: I have a fracture in my leg from the fall.
words.ex_cn: 我从摔倒后腿上有了骨折。
words.en: a break in a bone of the leg

words.tr: phrase. 石膏模型；石膏绷带；石膏模塑
words.ex: The doctor put a plaster cast on my broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我骨折的手臂上了石膏绷带。
words.en: A plaster cast is a hard protective covering made of plaster of Paris that is used to support and protect a broken bone while it heals, or a model made by pouring plaster into a mold.

words.tr: phrase. L形石膏固定；L形石膏管型
words.ex: The doctor applied an L-shaped plaster cast to stabilize the broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用了L形石膏绷带来固定断臂。
words.en: An L-shaped plaster cast is a type of cast used in medical treatment to immobilize and support a broken or injured limb, typically shaped like the letter 'L' to fit specific areas of the body.

words.tr: phrase. 打石膏；佩戴石膏绷带（用于固定骨折部位）
words.ex: After breaking his leg, he had to wear a plaster cast for six weeks.
words.ex_cn: v. 他摔断腿后，不得不佩戴石膏绷带六周。
words.en: To have a plaster cast on a part of the body, typically to support and protect a broken bone while it heals.

words.tr: n. 挫伤；擦伤；撞伤；
words.ex: He had a contusion on his arm after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒后手臂上有了一个挫伤。
words.en: A contusion is a bruise that appears on your skin after an injury.

words.tr: phrase. 割伤手指
words.ex: Be careful not to cut fingers while chopping vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 切菜时要小心，不要割伤手指。
words.en: To accidentally injure one's fingers with a sharp object.

words.tr:
v. 切；割；削减；
n. 切；割；削减；
words.ex: He cut the apple with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切了苹果。
words.en: To make an opening, incision, or wound in (something) with a sharp-edged tool or object.

words.tr: n. 伤口；创伤； v. “wind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He cleaned the wound with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水清洗了伤口。
words.en: A wound is damage to part of your body, especially a cut or a hole in your flesh, which is caused by a gun, knife, or other weapon.

words.tr: v. 消毒；灭菌；使绝育
words.ex: She will sterilize the bottles before use.
words.ex_cn: 她将在使用前消毒瓶子。
words.en: To sterilize something means to make it completely clean and free from bacteria.

words.tr: phrase. 消毒伤口，即杀死或去除伤口上的病原微生物以防止感染
words.ex: You should disinfect the wound to prevent infection.
words.ex_cn: 你应该给伤口消毒以防止感染。
words.en: To clean something, especially a wound, with a chemical that kills bacteria.

words.tr: v. 冲洗；
words.ex: Rinse the dishes with water before drying them.
words.ex_cn: 在晾干盘子之前用清水冲洗。
words.en: To rinse something means to wash it in clean water in order to remove soap or dirt.

words.tr: phrase. 清洗伤口
words.ex: The nurse will clean the wound before applying the bandage.
words.ex_cn: 护士会在包扎前清洁伤口。
words.en: To remove dirt, bacteria, or other harmful substances from a wound to prevent infection and promote healing.

words.tr: phrase. 缝合伤口
words.ex: The doctor will stitch the wound to prevent infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生将缝合伤口以防止感染。
words.en: To sew up a cut or wound in a person's body.

words.tr:
adj. 晒黑的；晒焦的 
v. 晒黑；晒伤；“sunburn”的过去式及过去分词
words.ex: The boy is sunburnt after playing outside all day.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在户外玩了一整天后晒伤了。
words.en: If someone is sunburnt, their skin is red and sore because they have spent too much time in hot sunshine.

words.tr: phrase. 蚊子叮咬；被蚊子咬后的肿块
words.ex: He scratched his arm after a mosquito bite.
words.ex_cn: 他被蚊子叮了之后抓了胳膊。
words.en: A mosquito bite is the result of a mosquito piercing the skin to feed on blood, often causing itching and swelling.

words.tr: phrase. 蜂蜇伤
words.ex: He got a bee sting on his arm.
words.ex_cn: 他的手臂被蜜蜂蜇了一下。
words.en: The act of a bee piercing the skin with its stinger, often causing pain and swelling.

words.tr: n. 大量同时出现的事件；
words.ex: There was a rash of burglaries last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月发生了一连串的盗窃案。
words.en: If someone is rash or does rash things, they act without thinking carefully first, and therefore make mistakes or behave foolishly.

words.tr: n. 水疱；气泡
words.ex: He got blisters from wearing new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他穿新鞋磨出了水泡。
words.en: Blisters are small pockets of fluid that form on the skin or other surfaces, often caused by friction, burns, or other irritation.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 跌倒；被绊倒；翻倒
words.ex: The boy falls over and cries.
words.ex_cn: 男孩摔倒了，哭了。
words.en: To fall over means to fall to the ground or to fall down from an upright position.

words.tr: phrase. 推倒；推翻；使失去平衡而倒下
words.ex: He pushed over the chair by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心把椅子推倒了。
words.en: To cause something to fall or tip over by applying force.

words.tr: phrase. v. 从楼梯上摔下来
words.ex: He fell down the stairs and hurt his knee.
words.ex_cn: 他从楼梯上摔下来，伤了膝盖。
words.en: To accidentally descend the stairs in an uncontrolled manner, often resulting in injury.

words.tr: phrase. v. 竭尽全力；不遗余力（常用于否定句，表示某人不愿意尽力帮忙）
words.ex: He fell over backwards when he tripped on the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他被绳子绊倒，向后摔倒了。
words.en: To make a great effort to do something, especially to help or please someone.

words.tr: phrase. （因药物等）产生幻觉；迷恋，沉溺于（某事物）
words.ex: He tripped on the carpet and fell.
words.ex_cn: 他被地毯绊了一下，摔倒了。
words.en: To stumble or fall over something; to make a mistake because of something.

words.tr: phrase. 遭受；患病
words.ex: He suffers from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他患了重感冒。
words.en: If you suffer from an illness or from a medical condition, you are badly affected by it.

words.tr: phrase. 感觉麻木的；失去知觉的
words.ex: He feels numb after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到麻木。
words.en: To experience a lack of sensation or emotion, often due to cold, shock, or fatigue.

words.tr: phrase. 持续性头痛的；经常头痛的
words.ex: He has constant headaches after working long hours.
words.ex_cn: 他长时间工作后总是头痛不止。
words.en: Persistent or continuous headaches that occur frequently over a period of time.

words.tr: 短语. 辗转反侧；形容因焦虑、不适或失眠而在床上翻来覆去睡不着
words.ex: He was tossing and turning all night because of the pain.
words.ex_cn: 他因为疼痛整晚翻来覆去睡不着。
words.en: If someone is tossing and turning, they are continuously moving around in bed and cannot sleep properly, usually because they are worried or uncomfortable.

words.tr: phrase. 处于痛苦中；感到疼痛
words.ex: He is in pain after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒后很疼。
words.en: Experiencing physical or mental suffering.

words.tr:
n. 疼痛；隐痛；渴望
v. 疼痛；隐痛
words.ex: My head aches after staying up late.
words.ex_cn: 我熬夜后头痛。
words.en: If you ache or a part of your body aches, you feel a steady, fairly strong pain.

words.tr: n. 牙痛
words.ex: He has a toothache and cannot eat.
words.ex_cn: 他牙疼，不能吃东西。
words.en: A toothache is a pain in or around a tooth.

words.tr: phrase. 腿在疼；腿部感到疼痛
words.ex: His leg is in pain after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后腿疼。
words.en: the leg is experiencing discomfort or suffering

words.tr: phrase. 腿疼；腿部疼痛
words.ex: My leg hurts after running.
words.ex_cn: 我跑步后腿疼。
words.en: To experience pain in the leg.

words.tr: phrase. 腿感到疼痛；腿疼
words.ex: My leg feels pain when I walk.
words.ex_cn: 我走路时腿感到疼痛。
words.en: the leg has a sensation of pain

words.tr: phrase. 感觉我的腿疼；腿部感到疼痛
words.ex: I feel pain in my leg when I walk.
words.ex_cn: 我走路时腿疼。
words.en: To experience discomfort or soreness in the leg.

words.tr: phrase. 我的腿感到疼痛；腿疼
words.ex: I suffer pain in my leg when I walk.
words.ex_cn: 我走路时腿疼。
words.en: to feel pain in one's leg

words.tr: phrase. 感觉到腿疼；腿部有疼痛感
words.ex: I experience pain in my leg when I walk too much.
words.ex_cn: 我走太多路时，腿会感到疼痛。
words.en: to feel or undergo pain in one's leg

words.tr: phrase. 肠绞痛；腹部剧烈疼痛，常因肠道痉挛引起
words.ex: The baby cried because of colic pain.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝因为肠绞痛而哭闹。
words.en: Colic pain refers to severe, often fluctuating pain in the abdomen caused by the spasm of smooth muscle in the walls of the intestines, ureters, or bile ducts.

words.tr: phrase. 灼痛；烧灼感
words.ex: He felt a burning pain in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他感到手上有一种灼痛。
words.en: A burning pain is a sharp, intense pain that feels like it is caused by heat or fire.

words.tr: phrase. 搏动性疼痛；跳痛（指有节奏地一跳一跳的剧烈疼痛）
words.ex: He has a throbbing pain in his head.
words.ex_cn: 他头痛得厉害。
words.en: A throbbing pain is a type of pain that comes in regular beats or pulses, often described as a rhythmic, pulsating sensation.
